traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.description: If the mammoth moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the mammoth can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action. Stomp: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. (Descriptive only: no prone-target gate, so Stomp is not an action. "Straight toward" isn't checked. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.
